full_read_matches.assessment: Two-item grammar/cost search: item count mu1, lexicographic count/new-form-arity mu2. Fast profile additions require rule-free base; cost2 pruning uses mention and unused datum/form/rule arguments, with naive replay comparator defined separately. Full reference enumeration is only0..2 items; larger max_items can raise when search reaches3. Fast checker assumes well-formed deltas and fresh data count, while delta_events uses w{n} without checking collision against arbitrary admitted tokens; outside engine naming discipline a purported fresh datum can deduplicate and following instance fail replay. Bounds has no validation; completeness is conditional on supported bounds and pruning assumptions. No unbounded minimization or model call.

Explicit L/F admission readings and metatheoretic pair-separation/supply policies; no endogenous demand generator is derived. Challenge reports compute finite minima and record grammar/arity bounds. Branch BFS merges canonical states with verified isomorphism witnesses, replays stored histories and naive-checks accepted response representatives; node guard is pre-expansion and may be exceeded by one expansion. completed denotes depth budget, not closure; terminal_all_separated denotes actual finite closure when supply disabled. closure_challenge_orbits chooses least raw pair per orbit: quotient transitions can be equivariant although docstring literal challenge-set equivariance is too strong. Fresh supply g{n} and delta w{n} presume controlled token namespace. Assertions are Python checks, removable under -O.

Computes structural isomorphism forgetting presentation tokens: data/form bijections preserve arities, instances, rules and unordered requirements. Invariant color refinement restricts permutations;100000-permutation budget fails explicitly. Refined and brute-force keys need not equal as values; agreement concerns induced equivalence classes. find_iso composes/inverts canonical witnesses and re-verifies serialization. Automorphism/pair orbits are computed exhaustively within budget. rename/serialize assume valid bijections and well-formed regimes; no input validation. Least orbit representatives provide quotient-level invariance, not an equivariant raw representative set.

Immutable public Regime is not constructor-validated; step validates events assuming a well-formed base, uses presentation-string equality to deduplicate datum admissions, treats Supply as no-op, requires positive form arity and range/arity-correct instances. Impose validates ordered finite pair but does not require current satisfaction; replay certification is equality with a supplied history, not semantic satisfaction. Presentation equality and finite indices are admitted metatheory. Token strings have no reservation policy, relevant to candidate fresh-name assumptions.

Complete finite contexts enumerate holes/data for every declared form arity; all holes receive the same datum. Profile is positive instance/rule derivability; collapse is profile equality and separability its inequality. Uniform rules contribute identically across data. Context enumeration is exponential in arity; constructors/derivable do not independently enforce well-formedness, relying on replayed regimes. collapsed_pairs comment assumes an accepted regime satisfies requirements; the function itself accepts unsatisfied states.
